proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the engine code/ID plate or stamped code on the engine block (and where it is located).
Send a cold-start running video (with sound) showing it runs smoothly with no knock.
Send scan tool results (fault codes) and/or compression test results.
Confirm completeness: list what is included (turbo, alternator, starter, ECU/MAF sensors, wiring harness, intake parts) and send photos of each included item.
response.reason: The photos show a complete engine assembly, but the exact engine identity (engine code/model) and the “tested/working/no knock/low mileage/never opened” claims are not verifiable from the provided images. Without the identifying code and proof of running condition, a worst-case price cannot be confidently matched to the correct comparable.
